name.description: The name of the {@ReliabilityMetric} to plot.

dependencyMetrics.description:
The metrics that are being used to create the new metric.
The preview chart will show the metrics that are being used to create the new metric.
If this array is empty, it means that the new metric that is being created is a simple metrics, that only involves
sensors.
If this array is not empty, it means that the new metric that is being created is a compound metric.

dependencySensors.description:
The sensors that are being used to create the new metric.
The preview chart will show the sensors that are being used to create the new metric.
If this array is empty, it means that the new metric that is being created is a compound metric, that only involves
metrics.

relatedAssetIds.description: The ids of the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s that can be related to the expression based on the sensor it contains.

relatedFacilityIds.description: The ids of the {@link Facility} that can be related to the expression based on the sensor it contains.

newMetricExpression.description: The expression of the new metric that is being created.

start.description: The start time of the data to be plotted.

end.description: The end time of the data to be plotted.

interval.description: The interval to plot all of the metric data in the chart at.
